h: Tinubu reportedly launches his APC re-election campaign with a flag-off in Kaduna
p: The APC is said to have formally opened its 2027 presidential campaign in Kaduna, with President Tinubu delivering the keynote address. The full text of his speech has been circulating online. The campaign is reportedly set to move on to Port Harcourt and Maiduguri.
more: The flag-off follows the NDC and ADC unveiling their own campaign councils.
Supporters and critics have been reacting to the speech online.
The next campaign stops are reportedly Rivers and Borno states.
